picks.title: Prentis, new AI lab co-founded by Reid Hoffman, Mark Pincus in talks to raise $100M
picks.why_it_matters: Signals a major thesis shift from top-tier founders that AI-powered task automation (not code generation) may be the next massive application layer opportunity for startups to build against.

picks.title: India's first privately-developed rocket reaches orbit on debut launch
picks.why_it_matters: Validates India's emerging private space ecosystem as investment-worthy, opening doors for downstream startups in satellite services, manufacturing, and launch logistics across a new geography.

picks.title: White House draws new AI line on China
picks.why_it_matters: New regulatory posture on open AI and China IP theft claims will directly impact deal structuring, due diligence requirements, and exit pathways for AI startups with any cross-border exposure.
